title: Create valid robots.txt file in public/
description: Create public/robots.txt file with proper configuration for search engine crawling. Include sitemap reference and proper user-agent directives.

title: Enable JavaScript minification in Astro build
description: Configure Astro build process to minify JavaScript. Check astro.config.mjs and ensure Vite minification is enabled. Fix the Minify JavaScript audit failure (score 0.5).

title: Fix Cloudflare Insights console error
description: Fix the console error caused by Cloudflare Insights script being blocked. Either remove the script or configure it properly to prevent ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT error in browser console.

title: Generate favicon variations (apple-touch-icon, 32x32, 16x16)
description: Create multiple favicon sizes in public/ directory: favicon.ico (for legacy browsers), apple-touch-icon.png (180x180), icon-192.png, icon-512.png. Update index.astro to reference all variations.

title: Add main landmark role to page content
description: Add role='main' or <main> landmark to the main content wrapper in index.astro. The accessibility audit shows score 0 for missing main landmark.

title: Optimize Google Fonts loading (preconnect, display swap)
description: Improve Google Fonts loading by adding preconnect hints and font-display: swap. This will reduce FCP and improve CLS scores by preventing layout shifts from font loading.

title: Add Open Graph and Twitter Card meta tags
description: Add comprehensive social media meta tags (Open Graph and Twitter Cards) to index.astro head section. Include og:title, og:description, og:image, twitter:card, twitter:site.

title: Fix link accessibility - add discernible names
description: Add proper accessible names to icon-only links (LinkedIn, Mail icons). Use aria-label attributes to provide discernible names for screen readers. Audit shows score 0.

title: Add meta description tag to index.astro
description: Add comprehensive meta description tag (155-160 characters) to index.astro for better SEO. Include target keywords like full stack developer, Jakarta, React, Node.js.

title: Create XML sitemap.xml for search engines
description: Generate public/sitemap.xml file listing all pages for search engine discovery. Include the sitemap location in robots.txt. Consider using Astro's built-in sitemap integration.

title: Add JSON-LD structured data (Person schema)
description: Add Person schema markup using JSON-LD format in index.astro. Include name, job title, url, sameAs links to social profiles, and description for rich search results.

title: Reduce unused JavaScript in client bundles
description: Analyze client JavaScript bundles and reduce unused code. The audit shows 0.5 score for unused JS. Consider code splitting, tree shaking, or removing unnecessary dependencies.
